title: ERP Executive
description:
Position overview

* **Job title:** Frappe / ERPNext Executive
* **Company:** Shree Bhagwati Electromech Pvt. Ltd.
* **Department:** IT / ERP
* **Reports to:** IT Head / Managing Director
* **Location:** Domjur, Jalan Industrial Complex
* **Job type:** Full-time, on-site
* **Experience:** Minimum 2 years in Frappe / ERPNext
* **Qualification:** B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / MCA / B.Sc (IT) or equivalent

Job purpose

The Frappe / ERPNext Executive will run, support and improve the company's ERPNext system so that sales, purchase, inventory, manufacturing, accounts and HR work from one reliable source of data. The role combines day-to-day user support with configuration, customisation and reporting on the Frappe framework.

Key responsibilities

**ERPNext implementation and configuration**

* Configure ERPNext modules: Selling, Buying, Stock, Manufacturing, Accounts, HR and Payroll, as per company processes.
* Set up masters (items, BOMs, customers, suppliers, warehouses, chart of accounts, employees) and keep them clean.
* Map existing business processes to ERPNext workflows and suggest improvements.
* Configure GST settings, e-invoicing and e-way bill integration.

**Customisation and development (Frappe framework)**

* Create custom DocTypes, custom fields, Client Scripts and Server Scripts.
* Build workflows, approval rules, notifications and auto-email alerts.
* Design print formats (invoices, POs, delivery challans, payslips) using Jinja / HTML.
* Develop custom apps and integrations using Python, JavaScript and REST APIs where needed.

**Reports and dashboards**

* Build Script Reports, Query Reports and dashboards for management (sales, stock, production, receivables, payables).
* Provide MIS data to the MD and department heads on time.

**User support and training**

* Act as first point of contact for all ERPNext issues raised by users.
* Train new and existing users department-wise; prepare simple user manuals and SOPs.
* Manage user accounts, roles and permissions.

**System administration**

* Manage ERPNext updates, backups and restoration on Frappe Cloud or self-hosted server (bench, Linux).
* Monitor system performance, error logs and scheduled jobs.
* Coordinate with the ERPNext implementation partner or vendor, if any.

**Data management**

* Handle data migration and bulk imports through Data Import and Excel templates.
* Run periodic data audits to catch duplicate, missing or incorrect entries.

Required skills and qualifications

* Graduate in Computer Science / IT (B.E., B.Tech, BCA, MCA, B.Sc IT) or equivalent.
* Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with ERPNext (version 14 or 15) and the Frappe framework.
* Working knowledge of Python, JavaScript, Jinja, HTML/CSS and MariaDB/MySQL queries.
* Understanding of business processes: order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory, production and basic accounting.
* Familiarity with Indian GST, TDS and statutory compliance in ERPNext.
* Comfort with Linux commands, bench CLI, Git and server basics.
* Good communication in Hindi and English; patience in training non-technical users.
* Strong problem-solving ability and attention to data accuracy.

Preferred (good to have)

* Experience in a manufacturing or engineering company using the Manufacturing module (BOM, Work Order, Job Card).
* Frappe / ERPNext certification or contributions to Frappe community apps.
* Experience with Frappe Cloud, Docker or third-party integrations (WhatsApp, Tally, payment gateways).

What success looks like

* User issues resolved quickly, routine ones within 24 hours.
* ERPNext stays available during working hours with no data loss.
* Daily backups taken and restoration tested every month.
* MIS reports shared with management on schedule.
* All departments working fully in ERPNext, with no parallel Excel records.
* Clean, accurate masters and transactions during audits.

Pay: ₹22,000.00 - ₹33,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Senior HR Manager
description:
**About JMN Medical College and Hospital**  
JMN Medical College and Hospital is a 150\-seat MBBS institution recognised under the National Medical Commission and located at Uttar Panchpota, Chakdaha, Nadia. We are a young institution building our systems, culture and reputation from the ground up, and the people we hire now will design how this institution works for years to come.

**The Role**  
We are looking for an HR Manager of high intelligence and sharp judgement to lead the full people function for teaching, non\-teaching and administrative staff. You will make sure the institution attracts, develops and retains the right people while staying fully compliant with NMC staffing norms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and run faculty and staff recruitment in line with NMC Teachers Eligibility Qualifications and minimum staffing requirements.
* Maintain accurate faculty records and prepare HR documentation for NMC inspections and declarations.
* Manage onboarding, performance appraisal, training and staff development.
* Administer payroll inputs, attendance systems, leave and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity, Professional Tax).
* Draft and implement HR policies, service rules and grievance procedures.
* Anticipate staffing gaps and build retention strategies for faculty.

**Who You Are**

* You think strategically about people. You forecast faculty needs against NMC norms, attrition and growth, well before gaps appear.
* You read people accurately and spot talent, potential and risk that others miss.
* You reason from first principles and design HR systems that are fair, measurable and hard to game.
* You master new regulations quickly and turn them into clear, workable policy.
* You decide well under pressure and hold yourself to exacting standards of accuracy and integrity.

**Digital and AI Skills**

* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets: formulas, pivot tables, dashboards.
* Hands\-on experience with HRMS, digital attendance and applicant\-tracking systems.
* You look for ways to automate repetitive HR work, and you learn new tools quickly without waiting for training.

**Requirements**

* MBA/PGDM in HR or equivalent.
* 6–10 years of HR experience, with at least 3 years in a managerial role.
* Experience in a medical college, hospital or higher\-education institution preferred.
* Sound knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance.

**Selection Process**  
Our selection process tests how you think, not only what you know:

* CV and cover letter shortlisting
* Assessment of analytical, logical and psychometric reasoning
* Panel interview with institutional leadership

**How to Apply**  
Apply through Indeed with your CV and a one\-page cover letter. In the cover letter, describe the most complex problem you have solved and how you reasoned through it, and one tool, automation or AI application you introduced that made your work measurably better.

*Remuneration will be commensurate with qualifications, experience and demonstrated ability. JMN Medical College and Hospital is an equal opportunity employer.*

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹75,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

Application Question(s):

* Describe the most complex HR problem you have solved. What made it hard and how did you approach it?
* Which HR software and AI tools do you use regularly, and how have they improved your work?

title: Nepal- Talent & Culture Manager
description:
**Mission** 

Lead the Talent \& Culture function for **Christel House Nepal**, ensuring effective and consistent people practices across the employee lifecycle—from talent attraction and onboarding to performance, development, engagement, compensation, wellbeing, and offboarding.

The role will serve as a strategic partner to the Executive Director and leadership team, helping build a strong organizational culture aligned with Christel House’s mission and supporting the organization as it grows and evolves.

The Talent \& Culture Lead will promote a culture grounded in Christel House values: **Integrity, Continuous Learning, Inclusive Teamwork, Passion for Results, and Effective Communication**, ensuring employees have a positive, inclusive, and growth\-oriented experience.

.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Talent \& Organizational Partnership**

* Serve as a strategic partner to the Executive Director and leadership team on talent, leadership, organizational structure, culture, and people\-related decisions.
* Identify talent\-related risks and opportunities, including performance, succession, engagement, retention, and organizational capability.
* Participate in organizational planning and ensure Talent \& Culture priorities are aligned with Christel House Nepal’s strategic objectives.
* Support leaders in building effective teams and strengthening leadership capabilities.

**Talent Management \& Employee Lifecycle**

* Lead recruitment and selection processes, ensuring transparent, equitable, and effective hiring practices aligned with Christel House values.
* Oversee onboarding and integration of new employees.
* Coordinate employment documentation, payroll\-related employee information, benefits, leave, and other employee processes in collaboration with Finance and external providers as appropriate.
* Lead performance management processes, supporting leaders and employees in setting objectives, providing feedback, and creating development plans.
* Coordinate learning and development initiatives based on organizational and individual needs.
* Identify strategies to develop and retain talent, particularly in critical or strategic roles.
* Support employee transitions and offboarding processes in a professional, respectful, and compliant manner.

**Culture, Engagement \& Employee Experience**

* Lead initiatives that strengthen organizational culture, inclusion, collaboration, and employees’ sense of belonging.
* Promote employee wellbeing and a healthy and supportive work environment.
* Support leaders and teams in addressing employee relations issues and workplace conflicts.
* Coordinate employee engagement and organizational climate surveys, analyze results, and support the development and implementation of action plans.
* Promote recognition, open communication, collaboration, and connection across teams.
* Support internal communication related to people, culture, policies, and organizational initiatives.

**HR Operations \& Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain accurate and confidential employee records and information.
* Ensure Talent \& Culture practices comply with applicable Nepalese employment and labor requirements and organizational policies.
* Develop, document, and continuously improve Talent \& Culture policies, processes, and procedures.
* Support the administration of the Talent \& Culture budget and related programs.
* Maintain and improve HR systems and employee data.
* Develop relevant people metrics, reports, and insights to support leadership decision\-making.
* Collaborate closely with Finance, Operations, Academic leadership, and other functions to ensure effective people practices.

**Organizational Development \& Change**

* Support organizational change and growth, helping employees and leaders navigate transitions effectively.
* Strengthen organizational capabilities in talent management, culture, leadership, and employee development.
* Collaborate with Christel House International to implement global Talent \& Culture practices and standards while appropriately adapting them to the Nepal context.
* Identify future Talent \& Culture needs and recommend improvements to processes, capabilities, and organizational structure as Christel House Nepal develops.

**Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in Human Resources, Talent Management, or People \& Culture, preferably in a generalist role.
* Experience across key HR areas such as recruitment, performance management, employee development, engagement, and employee relations.
* Experience supporting leaders and contributing to organizational culture and change.
* Knowledge of applicable employment and labor requirements in Nepal.
* Experience in education, nonprofit, or social\-impact organizations is desirable.
* Strong communication skills in English and Nepali.
* Strong interpersonal skills, judgment, integrity, and ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders.

Pay: ₹1,700,000\.00 per year

title: Seasonal MyHR Live Support Sr. Advisor
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


This is a contract role  

  

The My HR Live Support (MHLS) team is currently seeking to hire an MHLS Sr. Advisor to support our Tier 2 Specialty Operation. The MHLS Tier 2 Specialty Team primarily provides customer service to Amazon employees through phone, chat, ticketing, and cases related to payroll, disability, policies, among others. This role will act as a point of contact for the team, offering immediate assistance on complex issues and handling challenging contacts. The Sr. Advisors provide case consultations and overall resolution and support for all types of leaves of absence and disability life events to our Amazon employees. They are highly skilled in answering questions, obtaining the right information from SOPs and knowledge centers, providing direct support through different live and written channels, understanding the employee’s situation, applying appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances; and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. The Sr. Advisor will also escalate trends to management to address any training or quality gaps identified.  

  

The ideal candidate will possess exceptional communication and organizational skills, a keen attention to detail, the ability to prioritize in a fast\-paced environment, strong relationship\-building and influencing abilities, robust analytical and critical thinking skills, and a customer service focus that aligns with Amazon's global standards.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Respond to inquiries about disability and leave events, time\-off, payments, and work\-related situations available to employees.
* Inbound and Outbound phone, chat and case support through the Specialized Support Queues.
* Serve as a point of contact for employees to provide holistic case management services, including medical documentation review to adjudicate compliance with corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon.
* Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs.
* Address and respond to sensitive situations in benefit of employee experience and attempt to de\-escalate complex cases.
* Manage own workload effectively to meet productivity goals and escalate when significant changes or gaps in assigned workload arise.
* Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event.
* Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication and documentation occurs, even when information is limited.
* Use good judgement and rationale to balance process adherence with employee’s needs to analyze and decide on disability, leave and benefits requests.
* Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp\-back plan for employees returning to the workplace.
* Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to starting a leave or returning back to work.
* Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing.
* Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy.
* Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation.
* Consult, coordinate and partner with our third\-party administrator, local HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits team members and other support units as appropriate.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office including PowerPoint, Excel, and Word
* Minimum of 1 year experience in customer service or Human Resource management or Case management or Leave \& Disability management role

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of case management experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
* Experience identifying and resolving complex issues
* Experience managing confidential and sensitive employee information and adherence to strict confidentiality standards
* Ability to build strong relationships and influence others while working in a cross functional environment
* Experience providing guidance to employees or managers on leave of absence, disability plan, accommodation, human resources, benefits, or employee matters

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
